author: Codex
question: Does this bounded Echo checkpoint behave consistently with copying input data, and what has actually been exposed to optimizer updates?
echo_format: Q='01'+'00'+'0'+3 data bits+'0'; A=3 data bits+'0'; expected output=A+'S'
generation: Original maximum8 actions, context13 overflow guard, STOP terminates; no forced STOP or answer-length oracle
TF: Five true-prefix logits per legal Echo question: three data bits, tail0, STOP. Cache24 data logits for all pair diagnostics; no extra pair inference
current_bit_pairs: For each output position j, flip Q data bit j. Four unordered legal whole-Q pairs per j,12 total. Both sides share the same correct A[:j]. Report raw predicted-token flip separately from both-correct-and-follow
future_bit_pairs: For every j<k, predict output bit j and flip later Q data bit k. Four unordered legal whole-Q pairs per (j,k),12 conditional pairs over8 distinct whole-Q pairs. Both sides share correct A[:j]. Report raw token invariance separately from both-correct-and-invariant
pair_dependence: Pairs reuse24 logits and overlap in questions;12 conditional future tests are not12 independent whole-question pairs or statistical samples
excluded_primary_intervention: Do not flip an already-output past data bit while freezing an incompatible old answer prefix
history: Read each actual trace tuple (op,value,prediction_string), ignore prediction_string for teacher construction. Reconstruct true A and every optimizer raw prefix/next label in chronological phase/lesson/position order. Sum target occurrences must equal checkpoint.t. Validation/test probing does not count as optimizer exposure
history_order_check: Original AST-only symbolic Schedule with seed=base seed+100*phase index must exactly reproduce every actual trace op/value pair; no optimizer replay
curriculum_prefix_support: Report unique current Echo training examples' correct answer-prefix to next-bit support/count, independent of neural scores, without selecting a prediction or tie strategy
exposure_fields: Separate whole training Q, full teacher answer bits/answer with STOP, and per-evaluation raw-prefix label counts. Prefix categories unseen/same_only/conflict_only/mixed; include last label, first/last phase and global target index. A new whole Q does not imply every raw prefix is unseen
state_guard: AST-only load the pinned reference Model after equality to historical Model AST. Never import either legacy module or main. Hard deny Model.step/lesson/loss_grad/grow and forward(training=True). Exact saved p/m/v/birth/t/L/H/growth_rng before/after; all source/checkpoint/trace raw hashes before/after
execution_gate: Prepare input manifest and source freeze plus synthetic engineering first. Actual checkpoint inference requires explicit approved manifest SHA and a new output directory after coordinator/reviewer gate
costs: Record new inference calls and dense MAC H*(2L+3); pair computation adds zero inference. Historical NPZ lacks seed/events/train/inference counters, so restored learning state is exact but diagnostic counters start at0 and are not historical cost reconstruction
limits: Eight three-bit inputs are an exposed finite domain, not proof of an unbounded copy algorithm or neural memorization. Before/after snapshots describe change only; additional updates and Echo exposure also change, so do not causally attribute the difference to Neg
